note: The rest of data/_unplaced-context.json, placed only where the collection title names the state or province that settles which place of that name it is. A US county is matched against Wikidata's counties and their seats, because data/gazetteer.json is GeoNames cities5000 and carries no state at all -- which is how the first pass put Etowah County, Alabama in Etowah, North Carolina. `why` records what decided each one; `unplaced` records why the others were left alone, and a wrong dot is worse than a missing one.
source: Wikidata (US counties and their seats, Italian comuni, Dutch municipalities) + FamilySearch collection titles and waypoint paths
